meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: Assists in writing high-quality content by conducting research, adding citations, improving hooks, iterating on outlines, and providing real-time feedback on each section. Transforms your writing process from solo effort to collaborative partnership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过调研、引用和实时反馈提升写作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效完成高质量文章或内容创作
copy.tagline_en: Improve writing quality with research, citations, and real-time feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce high-quality articles or content efficiently

howto.what: 这个技能装好后,Claude 会变成你的写作搭子:帮你想文章结构、查资料加引用、改进开头,还会在你写每一节时给反馈。它会尽量保持你原来的语气和风格。
howto.when: 在你写博客、文章或教程时触发;或请它帮忙列大纲、查资料、改开头等。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于AI产品的文章大纲
say.note: 会先问几个问题,再搭出带研究待办的结构

say.text: 查一下AI对产品经理的影响,给大纲加引用
say.note: 会去搜资料,整理成带来源的要点

say.text: 我刚写完“为什么这很重要”一节,帮我点评一下
say.note: 会按清晰度、逻辑、证据、风格逐项点评

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a writing partner: helps structure outlines, researches and adds citations, improves hooks, gives section-by-section feedback, preserves your voice, manages references, and refines iteratively.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you write blog posts, articles, or tutorials, or when you ask for help with outlining, research, or hook improvement, etc.

say_en.text: Help me write an outline for an article about AI products.
say_en.note: Builds a structured outline with research to-dos.

say_en.text: Research AI's impact on product managers and add citations to my outline.
say_en.note: Searches sources and compiles findings with proper citations.

say_en.text: I just finished the 'Why This Matters' section. Review it and give feedback.
say_en.note: Reviews clarity, flow, evidence, and style with line edits.
